KFP.Title: Force Presence
KFP.Settings.PublicCards.Name: Public resolution cards
KFP.Settings.PublicCards.Hint: Post end-of-session results to the whole table. Off by default: the base rules let a player keep their alignment secret, so cards are whispered to the GM and the character's owner.
KFP.Panel.StartingChoice.Label: Starting choice
KFP.Panel.StartingChoice.Light: Flip one Balance Point to Light Side
KFP.Panel.StartingChoice.Dark: Flip one Balance Point to Dark Side
KFP.Panel.StartingChoice.Confirm: Take "{choice}" as this character's starting choice? This can only be done once.
KFP.Panel.MoralityUnused: Not used under Force Presence. The Balance scale replaces the Morality score.
KFP.Threshold.DarkSide: Dark Side Threshold: strain threshold −2, wound threshold +2, generate Force points using dark side results.
KFP.Threshold.Paragon: Light Side Paragon: strain threshold +2. A dark side Force user at this point is redeemed and generates using light side results.
KFP.Threshold.Consumed: Consumed by the dark side: seek redemption or become an NPC controlled by the GM. Redemption needs seven Light Side Balance Points.
KFP.Threshold.DestinyFlip: At the start of each session, flip one Destiny Point from Light to Dark, after all rolls are completed.
KFP.Threshold.DestinyBonus: At the start of each session, add one bonus Light Side point to the Destiny Pool, after all rolls are completed.
KFP.Threshold.Reminder: This module reports these effects; it does not apply them.
KFP.Window.Title: Force Presence
KFP.Window.NoCanvas: Force Presence cannot open from the scene controls while no scene is active — Foundry discards every scene-control click without a canvas. Activate a scene, or open it from Settings → Force Presence.
KFP.Window.DestinyFlip: Flips a Destiny Point at session start
KFP.Window.DestinyBonus: Adds a Destiny Point at session start
KFP.Window.PreviewNoMove: No Balance Point available to move
KFP.Window.DeadlineNote: A player who does not answer within {seconds} seconds falls to you.
KFP.Prompt.Lead.Dark: {name} earned more Conflict than Tranquility. One Balance Point becomes Dark Side.
KFP.Prompt.Lead.Light: {name} earned more Tranquility than Conflict. One Balance Point moves one step toward the Light Side.
KFP.Sweep.Title: End of Session
KFP.Sweep.Reset: Conflict or Tranquility changed while waiting — that character was recomputed.
KFP.Sweep.NoChange: Conflict and Tranquility were equal; the scale is unchanged.
KFP.Sweep.AlreadyOpen: A sweep is already open, started by {gm}.
KFP.Sweep.ForceCloseConfirm: Release the open sweep? Characters already resolved stay resolved; this only clears the lock so a new sweep can start.
KFP.Sweep.NotActiveGM: Only the active GM can run the end-of-session resolution.
KFP.Sweep.NoTransport: socketlib is not available, so players cannot be asked — every character will fall to you.
KFP.Sweep.NoCharacters: No characters are tracking Force Presence.
KFP.Card.Summary: End of session resolved for {count} character(s).
KFP.Card.SummaryFailed: End of session resolved for {count} character(s). Failed: {failed}.
KFP.Convert.Title: Convert from Morality
KFP.Convert.Lead: Seed Balance scales from these characters' Morality scores:
KFP.Convert.Lossy: A Morality score is a single number and cannot describe a three-state scale, so each result is one-sided with the rest Neutral. Adjust by hand afterwards if you want something more nuanced.
KFP.Convert.Seeded: Converted {count} character(s) from their Morality score.
KFP.Convert.SkippedInitialized: {count} already have a Balance scale and will be left alone.
KFP.Convert.SkippedUntracked: {count} are not using the Morality system and will be left at ten Neutral.
KFP.Convert.NothingToDo: Nothing to convert: {initialized} already have a scale, {untracked} are not using Morality.
